result.topic_en: Pencil calculations: the upper half manipulates expressions in $\sin\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a$, $\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a$ and integrals $\int_0^a P\,\Lambda\,dx$ (apparently boundary conditions for a differential equation); the lower half expands $(y+\frac1y)^m\pm(y-\frac1y)^m$ and $(1+p)^m+(1-p)^m$ binomially and computes coefficients of polynomial relations for $q$.

methods.what: Combination of boundary expressions yielding a relation between $(B_a-A_a)F_\lambda$ and an integral of $\Lambda_1P$
Analogous relation for the derivative boundary terms with $\Lambda_2$
Binomial expansion of the sum $(y+1/y)^m+(y-1/y)^m$, keeping even-index terms
Binomial expansion of $(1+p-1)^m$ as an alternating sum
Recursive computation of $q_k$ with binomial coefficients
